title: Panda-style OTHRYS workstation shell
goal: Make Command Centre visually match the proven PandaOS workstation patterns while preserving canonical V2 truth and authority boundaries.
laws: Presentation only: no execution authority or gate relaxation.
Keep the three-layer split: navigation, chat/workspace, durable Progress.
Make tablet landscape the primary composition target.
Keep approval and evidence visibly distinct.
Reuse existing V2 data and controls; do not invent Panda dependencies.
All existing Command Deck tests must remain green.
